chapter: Trumpet teachers and St. Louis heroes
title: Breathing, and how a teacher would treat Dizzy
summary: Langford insisted on breathing, but would leave a natural player like Dizzy Gillespie alone. Thomas says he gets pressure from the diaphragm.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
